summary: Apply IFRS 17 measurement, CSM, reinsurance and disclosure methods. Build practical implementation skills. Enquire about this five-day course.
lede: IFRS 17 implementation training supports insurance finance, actuarial, risk and assurance professionals responsible for measurement and reporting. It addresses the practical task of building reviewable processes amid legacy systems and data gaps, including mapping data dependencies, calculating illustrative fulfilment cash flows, and reconciling contractual service margin movements for reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or govern IFRS 17 measurement and reporting across an insurer’s finance, actuarial, risk, technology and assurance functions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of insurance financial reporting or actuarial work is recommended. Familiarity with insurance contract cash flows and financial statement close processes will help you complete the applied exercises. No programming is required.
